headline.en: Adeyemi started at Elche. Gordon started against Athletic
headline.es: Adeyemi fue titular en Elche. Gordon lo fue ante el Athletic

summary.en: Karim Adeyemi started the Liga opener at Elche. Anthony Gordon started the next match against Athletic and played 80 minutes. Both can play on the left. Flick has not named his starter for Rayo on Monday.
summary.es: Adeyemi salio en Elche. Gordon salio ante el Athletic y jugo 80 minutos. Los dos pueden jugar a la izquierda.

body.en:
Karim Adeyemi started Barcelona's first Liga match at Elche. Anthony Gordon started the second, against Athletic Club, and stayed on for 80 minutes. El Nacional wrote that Gordon did not expect to begin the season as a rotation player. Both were signed to give Flick another runner when Raphinha needs to come off or rest.

Rayo Vallecano usually defend deep, which is the kind of game Adeyemi was bought to attack with runs in behind. A side that tries to play out of the first press is closer to the work Gordon did against Athletic. Flick does not have to settle the hierarchy for the year on Monday. He does have to pick one of them for 21:30.

headline.en: Yamal played 90 minutes against Athletic and had seven shots
headline.es: Yamal jugo 90 minutos ante el Athletic y remato siete veces

summary.en: Lamine Yamal played the whole match against Athletic Club. MARCA counted seven shots, three on target, five chances created, 45 completed passes and three dribbles. Unai Simon and the post denied him a goal. After Elche, Flick had said Yamal was returning from three weeks off.
summary.es: Yamal jugo los 90 ante el Athletic. MARCA le conto siete tiros, tres a puerta y cinco ocasiones. Simon y el palo evitaron el gol.

body.en:
Lamine Yamal played about an hour at Elche and the full 90 minutes against Athletic Club four days later. MARCA's count from the Athletic night was seven shots, three on target, five chances created, 45 completed passes and three dribbles. He hit the post. Unai Simon made the saves that stopped a goal.

Flick had already said after Elche that Yamal was coming back from three weeks of holiday and only a few days of full training. Luis de la Fuente has spoken about calling him into the Spain squad. Barcelona play Rayo on Monday and Feyenoord on 9 September at 18:45. The staff can still keep the next step shorter than 90 minutes. They can also play him again and take him into that European week at full load. There is no injury bulletin. The decision is the number of minutes, not whether he can create chances.

headline.en: Barcelona beat Athletic 2-0. Raphinha and Fermin scored
headline.es: El Barca gano 2-0 al Athletic. Marcaron Raphinha y Fermin

summary.en: Barcelona beat Athletic Club 2-0 at Camp Nou. Mundo Deportivo wrote that Unai Simon and two shots against the post kept the score down. Raphinha and Fermin Lopez scored. Cubarsi and Pedri started. Gavi did not. Barcelona have seven Liga goals and none conceded.
summary.es: El Barca gano 2-0. Raphinha y Fermin marcaron. Siete goles a favor y cero en contra.

body.en:
Athletic Club left Camp Nou with a 2-0 defeat. Raphinha scored. Fermin Lopez scored. Both arrived in the space a centre-forward would usually occupy. Pau Cubarsi started in defence. Pedri started in midfield. Gavi was absent. Gordon started on the left.

Mundo Deportivo said Unai Simon and two shots against the woodwork stopped the night becoming a larger score. Barcelona have now scored seven times in two Liga matches and have not conceded. Elche were beaten 5-0. Athletic were a harder evening and still left with nothing. Rayo Vallecano visit on Monday and will defend deeper than both of those sides.
